title: Trial Quiz
document:
Dear Students,

I hope you are all doing well.

As you are aware, your unit schedule — including all Workshop Sessions — forms part of your official timetable. Announcements regarding activities, including the Trial Quiz, are made through the usual unit channels, and attendance at Workshop Sessions is expected as a default commitment on your part.

The Trial Quiz is made available exclusively during the Workshop Session. It is not offered at any other time, so your presence during those sessions directly determines your ability to attempt it.

It was also announced on Ed Forum:

https://edstem.org/au/courses/33953/discussion/3318837

(I can see 750 views - students were viewing this post)

For those of you who were unable to attend due to circumstances beyond your control, I understand that life can sometimes present unavoidable situations. However, in order for me to consider any form of accommodation, you will need to provide a valid Medical Certificate (MC) as supporting documentation. Without this, I am unfortunately unable to make exceptions, as it ensures fairness to all students in the cohort who made a commitment to attend during the scheduled time to take the trial quiz.

Please email your sick leave directly to me if you want to sit for the trial quiz.

Warm regards,

Dr. Nailah
